THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER 1. Accused in Crime No.89/2024 registered by Shivamogga Women Police Station, Shivamogga, for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 417 and 506 of IPC, is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.89/2024 was registered by Shivamogga Women Police Station, Shivamogga, for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC, on the basis of the first information dated 28.08.2024 received from the victim girl.
During the course of investigation, petitioner herein was arrested on 29.08.2024.
Bail application filed by him before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Crl.Misc.No.1156/2024 was rejected on 14.11.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner is a lecturer in Sanjay Memorial NC: 2024:KHC:51320 Polytechnic College in Shivamogga.

Even if the allegations made in the first information are presumed to be true, it is evident that the relationship between the parties was consensual and only after the said relationship got strained, a false complaint has been filed.
Petitioner has no other criminal antecedents.
He is a married person.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
He submits that petitioner had suppressed the fact that he was a married man and he had promised the victim girl that he will marry her and had sexual intercourse with her.
Accordingly, he prays to dismiss the petition.

6. From a perusal of the material available on record, it is found that the victim girl aged about 19 years was a student studying paramedical course in Raghavendra Paramedical Science College and since she had informed her friend Sachin that she was finding it difficult to understand her subjects,
her friend Sachin allegedly introduced her to the petitioner, who is a lecturer.
It appears that thereafter petitioner and the victim girl developed a relationship.
Allegation in the first information NC: 2024:KHC:51320 is that on the promise of marrying the victim girl, petitioner had taken her to various places and had sexual intercourse with her.

He also had threatened her that he will not Puneeth J N vs State By on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65888608/
2 marry her if she reveals the act committed by him to anybody.

sentences.text: Victim had got acquainted to the petitioner in the month of November, 2023 itself and it appears that for a considerable period of time, they were in a relationship and only in the month of August, 2024, after petitioner allegedly had called her parents and informed that victim girl was not regularly coming to college, she had approached the police and submitted the first information.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Undisputedly, petitioner is a lecturer working in a College and he is a married person.
The allegations now found in the charge sheet is required to be proved in a full fledged trial.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail needs to be answered affirmatively.
Accordingly, the following order:-
7. The petition is allowed.
